title: AcceptedSessionOutcome
description: One accepted Session's terminal abandonment classification.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

accepted_decisions.description: How many accepted Developer decisions this Session contains.

explicit_accepted_decisions.description: How many accepted decisions came from an explicit developer gesture.

last_decision_at.description: The Session's newest decision time, which anchors the grace horizon.

as_of.description: The newest timestamp in the Facts read by the Derivation.

status.description: The Session's closed terminal classification: committed, abandoned, in_flight, or attribution_unavailable.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
